title: sddm-theme: showlogo=shown has no effect
line: With showlogo=shown, the Breeze login screen now shows the logo and its shadow at the top of the screen at all times, not only after the screen sits idle for a minute.
explanation: The Breeze SDDM theme gave the logo and its shadow an opacity of 0 while the login UI was visible, so they could only appear (at the bottom, above the action buttons) after the UI faded out following 60 seconds without input. With a plain colour background the UI never fades, so the logo never appeared, and with an image most people never waited long enough to see it. The logo and its shadow are now always visible at the top centre of the screen, where they don't collide with the action buttons and footer, and the clock is centred in the space between the logo and the user list.

commits.message:
sddm-theme: always show the logo when showlogo is set

The logo and its shadow only appeared at the bottom once the login UI
faded out, which never happens with a plain colour background. Show them
at the top of the screen at all times instead, with the clock below.

BUG: 468070

patches.diff:
From 4958bfb2b71454951b50fc029f9df492cff4a75c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:31:50 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] sddm-theme: always show the logo when showlogo is set

The logo and its shadow only appeared at the bottom once the login UI
faded out, which never happens with a plain colour background. Show them
at the top of the screen at all times instead, with the clock below.

BUG: 468070
---
 sddm-theme/Main.qml | 25 +++++--------------------
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 20 deletions(-)

diff --git a/sddm-theme/Main.qml b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
index 3379ead93e..604d991b32 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/Main.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
@@ -135,9 +135,10 @@ Item {
         Clock {
             id: clock
             property Item shadow: clockShadow
-            visible: y > 0 && config.showClock === "true"
+            readonly property real spaceTop: logo.visible ? logo.y + logo.height : 0
+            visible: y > spaceTop && config.showClock === "true"
             anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-            y: (userListComponent.userList.y + mainStack.y)/2 - height/2
+            y: (spaceTop + userListComponent.userList.y + mainStack.y)/2 - height/2
             Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignBaseline
         }
 
@@ -391,14 +392,6 @@ Item {
             samples: 14
             spread: 0.3
             color : "black" // shadows should always be black
-            opacity: loginScreenRoot.uiVisible ? 0 : 1
-            Behavior on opacity {
-                //OpacityAnimator when starting from 0 is buggy (it shows one frame with opacity 1)"
-                NumberAnimation {
-                    duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration
-                    easing.type: Easing.InOutQuad
-                }
-            }
         }
 
         Image {
@@ -406,20 +399,12 @@ Item {
             visible: config.showlogo === "shown"
             source: config.logo
             anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-            anchors.bottom: footer.top
-            anchors.bottomMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+            anchors.top: parent.top
+            anchors.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
             asynchronous: true
             sourceSize.height: height
-            opacity: loginScreenRoot.uiVisible ? 0 : 1
             fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
             height: Math.round(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 3.5)
-            Behavior on opacity {
-                // OpacityAnimator when starting from 0 is buggy (it shows one frame with opacity 1)"
-                NumberAnimation {
-                    duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration
-                    easing.type: Easing.InOutQuad
-                }
-            }
         }
 
         // Note: Containment masks stretch clickable area of their buttons to
--

media.caption: Plain colour background, showlogo=shown: no logo
Plain colour background, showlogo=shown: logo (with its shadow) at the top, clock below it
Image background, showlogo=shown, login UI visible: no logo
Image background, showlogo=shown, login UI visible: logo at the top
Image background after a minute idle: the logo only showed here, at the bottom (old design)
Image background after a minute idle: the logo stays at the top, the rest fades as before

review.text: Clean fix in plasma-desktop's Breeze SDDM theme that removes the idle-only opacity and animations from both logo and logoShadow, anchors the logo at the top center, and centers the clock cleanly between the logo and user list while keeping showlogo=hidden layout identical. All three states (plain color, image with UI visible, and image after idle fade) are well-evidenced and visually balanced, and the MR description appropriately flags the placement change for VDG input.
